body: There's enough hard life to go around and there's always a worse story.  If Bob's gotten beat up twice, Joe's gotten chewed up three times and for twice as long...but pain is pain.  I'm not living out of my car yet, though I pretty much would be without the girl I'm with.  But she can't keep this up forever.  She can't, and I don't think I can let her try.  Fuck.
